connectors.name: PORT.A (Grove) connector legend
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers or USB connector drawn; ordered left to right as printed in the PORT.A box

uncertain: Left and right edge columns sit at the same nine heights; the image does not show whether they are two single rows or one 2x9 header, so recorded as two 1-row connectors
PORT.A box (15, 13, 5V OUT, G) is a legend; physical contact order of the Grove connector is not drawn and was taken left to right as printed
Right-side pairs 'Tx 43', 'Rx 44', 'Rst EN', 'Boot 0': labels chosen as the pin-side text (43, 44, EN, 0) with the outer word in functions
notes: M5Stack Capsule pin label card. Left-column numbers are GPIO numbers printed without a G prefix (kept as printed); 'n' is printed above 'WAKE' (recorded as nWAKE). Internal functions (RST/OFF, IR G4, WAKE BTN G42, buzzer G2, BAT/2 ADC G6, BTN0, microSD CS:11 MI:39 MO:12 SCK:14, BM8563 SDA:8 SCL:10, mic CLK:40 DAT:41, USB D-:G19/D+:G20, RGB status G21) are not pins and were skipped. Color legend (ADC1/ADC2/no ADC/POWER) omitted per rule 6.
